newsitem.title: USA: Finova to sell unit to Green Tree for $610 million.
newsitem.headline: Finova to sell unit to Green Tree for $610 million.

text.p: Finova Group Inc., formerly known as GFC Financial Corp., said Monday it had entered into a definitive agreement to sell its Manufacturer and Dealer Services unit to Green Tree Financial Corp. for about $610 million.
The unit provides financing primarily for small businesses. The deal is expected to be completed by the end of November.
Finova said it decided to sell the unit as part of its move to concentrate on its core commercial finance activities.
Finova said the move will free up equity that can be invested in its more traditional businesses.
Following the news, Green Tree's stock gained $1.125 at $42.375, while Finova was off 25 cents at $62.25 on the New York Stock Exchange.
